headline: MORE ROWS

thumbnail.generation: Built-in image generation; export to YouTube JPEG
thumbnail.prompt:

Asset: final YouTube thumbnail, wide landscape exactly 16:9, 1280 by 720 pixels if possible, opaque background.

MORE ROWS
MORE EVIDENCE?

Replace all old model-comparison graphics (paired lines, histogram and error bars) with one clear conceptual illustration for statistical independence: a single physical tensile specimen in muted blue on the lower-left feeding several repeated measurement dots through branching navy lines, all dots the same teal colour to show their common origin; on the lower-right, three separate smaller specimens, each with its own distinct coloured dot and a short downward measurement connection. Use a balanced, spacious composition below the headline, with the LEARN logo area unobstructed.

No photorealism, no person, no 3D rendering, no extra symbols, no watermark. Avoid clutter. Keep it instantly readable at phone size. Preserve the reference's flat editorial appearance and strong visual hierarchy.
